title: LeadIntakeInput
description: Payload any channel adapter POSTs to the lead-intake webhook. Everything is optional except that a message OR a name plus a contact point must be present.

tenant_id.description: Client company this lead belongs to. Defaults to the platform owner tenant when omitted.

source.description: facebook | instagram | tiktok | website | whatsapp | email | referral | manual | test

channel.description: Where the reply should go: whatsapp | email | messenger | instagram_dm | web_chat | phone

test_mode.description: true = never contact the customer, mark all records as test

ai_mode.description: mock = skip the LLM and use the deterministic rule engine

lead_id.description: Existing lead id when continuing a conversation
